svg.title: G01-invite-people-removed
svg.desc: Arimo outlined design reference. Native iOS controls are schematic. Confirmed removal only: Nina’s row disappears immediately, without a Removed tombstone. Debby becomes Needs to accept again, because the roster changed; the original held link remains usable for the updated review. Create an invitation returns only after authoritative capacity is available. Local announcement: Nina’s invitation was removed.

g.aria-label: Each person gets a separate link.
